sn_login = apis.simple_note.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password='LddQFtz')
sn_token = sn_login['access_token']

# Determine today's weekday name in lowercase
now = datetime.now()
day_name = now.strftime('%A').lower()  # e.g., wednesday
print('datetime.now:', now.isoformat())
print('day_name:', day_name)

# Load workout plan note (Exercise Plan = note_id 2544 from earlier)
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2544, access_token=sn_token)
content = note['content']
print('note title:', note['title'])

# Parse duration_mins for the matching day block
import re
# Find the block starting at 'day: <day_name>' up to next 'day:' at start of line
pattern = r"day:\s*" + re.escape(day_name) + r"\n(.*?)(?:\n\w+?:|\Z)"  # not perfect
m = re.search(pattern, content, flags=re.S)
if not m:
    print('Could not find day block with pattern, falling back to line-based parse')
    lines = content.splitlines()
    # iterate to find 'day: X'
    duration_mins = None
    current_day = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.startswith('day:'):
            current_day = line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        if current_day == day_name and line.startswith('duration_mins:'):
            duration_mins = int(line.split(':',1)[1].strip())
            break
else:
    block = m.group(1)
    dm = re.search(r"duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", block)
    duration_mins = int(dm.group(1)) if dm else None

print('duration_mins:', duration_mins)

from datetime import datetime

# Login to Spotify
sp_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password='qMQyD0J')['access_token']

# From Simple Note, parse today's workout duration (Exercise Plan note_id=2544)
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password='LddQFtz')['access_token']
exercise_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2544, access_token=sn_token)
content = exercise_note['content']

today = datetime.now().strftime('%A').lower()
current_day = None
duration_mins = None
for line in content.splitlines():
    s = line.strip()
    if s.startswith('day:'):
        current_day = s.split(':',1)[1].strip()
    if current_day == today and s.startswith('duration_mins:'):
        duration_mins = int(s.split(':',1)[1].strip())
        break

print('today_day', today)
print('workout_duration_mins', duration_mins)

# Choose playlist with enough total_duration (seconds) for workout duration.
# Playlist totals observed previously; recompute quickly from library list.
all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=sp_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

playlist_totals=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=sp_token)
    songs=pl.get('songs', [])
    total_duration_sec = sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs if isinstance(s.get('duration',0),(int,float)))
    playlist_totals.append((p['playlist_id'], p['title'], len(songs), total_duration_sec))

# pick the shortest playlist that meets requirement, else pick the longest.
needed_sec = duration_mins * 60
candidates=[t for t in playlist_totals if t[3] >= needed_sec]
print('needed_sec', needed_sec)
print('candidates', sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[3]))
if candidates:
    chosen = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[3])[0]
else:
    chosen = sorted(playlist_totals, key=lambda x: x[3], reverse=True)[0]

print('chosen', chosen)

# Clear queue and play chosen playlist
apis.spotify.clear_song_queue(access_token=sp_token)
play_resp = apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=sp_token, playlist_id=chosen[0])
print('play_resp', play_resp)

# Verify queue duration
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=sp_token)
# queue is list of songs
queue_total_sec = sum(q.get('duration',0) for q in queue if isinstance(q.get('duration',0),(int,float)))
print('queue_song_count', len(queue))
print('queue_total_sec', queue_total_sec)
print('queue_total_mins', queue_total_sec/60)
print('queue_first5', [(q['position'], q['title']) for q in queue[:5]])
